proposals.evidence: Turner directly gives Oriya āṅguṭhi/āṅgṭhi/aũṭhi finger/toe under aṅguṣṭha. The Odisha/Bhatri survey aŋ(g)ṭi forms continue this digit stem with variable contraction and aspiration; the additional-k aṇḍki forms are excluded because their morphology needs separate evidence.
